configurations.name: 启动完整系统（前端 + 三个服务 + MySQL + Kafka）
configurations.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./railway-data-foundation/scripts/start-local.ps1" -Kafka -Demand; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw '后端或 Kafka 启动失败，请查看终端提示。' }; $env:Path = 'D:/Dev/node.js;' + $env:Path; & 'D:/Dev/node.js/npm.cmd' run dev --prefix ./railway-data-foundation/foundation-web -- --port 5173 --strictPort

configurations.name: 启动后端（Foundation + Provider + MySQL + Kafka）
启动后端（Foundation + Provider + MySQL，不含 Kafka）
停止本地服务（后端 + MySQL + Kafka）
configurations.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./railway-data-foundation/scripts/stop-local.ps1"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw '停止本地服务失败，请查看终端提示。' }; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./railway-data-foundation/scripts/stop-local-kafka.ps1"
